subject: SIG evidence & artifacts delivery for MediFlow - architecture, policies, runbooks
messages:
From: Laura Jennings <laura.jennings@mediflow.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: MediFlow Security Team <security@mediflow.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: SIG evidence request for MediFlow POC

Hi Connor / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick SIG questionnaire turnaround. Our security team did a first pass and asked for a few pieces of supporting evidence to validate some of the responses before we can approve the POC network access. Could you please provide the following artifacts by EOD Thursday (Dec 3):

- High-level network & component diagram showing VPCs, subnets, NAT/gateways, and where Redwood inference hosts are placed (PNG/PDF)
- Backup & retention policy for model artifacts and logs (policy doc)
- A short recovery runbook (screenshot + PDF) for KV-cache/serving-node failure, showing the steps and who is on-call
- IAM screenshots (console) that show role bindings for service accounts used in production
- Evidence of encryption at rest for model weights (KMS / HSM references or screenshots)
- Completed SIG attachments mapping (control numbers -> evidence file) if available

If you can drop these into a shareable Drive folder and send the link we will distribute to our reviewers. If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-min walkthrough with our security engineers.

Appreciate it — Laura
Laura Jennings
Security Operations Manager | MediFlow Systems
(415) 555-0198

---
(attachment: mediflow-sig-questions-20261201.pdf)

- Marissa will add the SOC2/contractual mapping and the control matrix.
- Neha will capture the IAM screenshots and the KV-cache runbook screenshots from the staging cluster.

Drive folder (private link, will update perms): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Aaa-BbCcDdEeFf:mediflow-sig-evidence

If you prefer a walkthrough we can do 12/4 10:00–10:30 PT — I can invite our infra engineer and CS lead.

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: INTERNAL: MediFlow SIG - artifacts to collect (deadline Thu EOD)

Marissa / Neha — looped you both in. Quick checklist so we don't miss anything:

Marissa:
- Upload SOC2 control mapping (sig_control_mapping.xlsx) and latest contract summary
- Add backup_policy_v2.pdf and any retention schedules
- Confirm any contractual encryption language and where it maps to KMS/HSM notes

Neha:
- IAM console screenshots (production roles for inference-service account)
- KV-cache recovery runbook screenshots (runbook_kvcache_recovery.png) + brief PDF export
- Export a redwood_network_diagram.drawio.pdf and a flattened PNG for the external team

Please upload to the Drive folder and mark the HubSpot task as updated when done. If there's anything you can't produce by EOD Thu, flag it in the thread and we'll ask for an extension.

Connor

---
(attachment: request_checklist.txt)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Jennings <laura.jennings@mediflow.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 16:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request for MediFlow POC

Connor / Neha / Laura — uploaded the bulk of requested artifacts into the Drive folder. Summary below with filenames.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Aaa-BbCcDdEeFf:mediflow-sig-evidence
Uploaded items (all in folder root):
- sig_control_mapping.xlsx (control -> evidence mapping, tabbed)
- backup_policy_v2.pdf (retention: logs 90 days, model artifacts 180 days)
- redwood_data_classification.pdf (policy excerpt)
- redwood_network_diagram.drawio.pdf (export)
- redwood_network_diagram.png (flattened view for reviewers)
- confidentiality_addendum_signed.pdf (contractual doc)

Neha — the runbook screenshots and IAM console exports are in the /screenshots subfolder.
Screen captures (examples):
- screenshots/runbook_kvcache_recovery.png
- screenshots/iam_inference_service_roles.png
- screenshots/kms_key_policy.png

Notes: the KV-cache recovery runbook references our on-call rotation (SRE PagerDuty) and the escalation path; I redacted pager phone numbers in the PDF export. If MediFlow needs unredacted operational contacts we'll coordinate via a signed NDA / secure channel.

HubSpot: I updated the task and attached the control mapping sheet to the contact record (HS ticket #9876543210).

If you want a walkthrough I can cover the architecture + backup controls; Connor can present the production IAM model.

Marissa Cole
Senior Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
